lease_database_lfc_interval.description: Lease File Cleanup (LFC) interval in seconds; how often KEA compacts and rewrites the lease file.

lease_database_persist.description: Whether to persist lease data to disk (file) even though it's in-memory storage. Must be true to enable file-based backup.

lease_database_name.description: Path to the CSV file used for lease persistence when persist=true.

hooks_libraries.description: List of hook libraries to load (e.g., for statistics, logging, or custom logic). Each element defines a library to load and optional parameters.

parameters.description: JSON object with library-specific configuration parameters.

reconnect_wait_time.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting to the lease database after a disconnect (0 = no delay; only relevant for non-memfile DBs; kept for structure).

db_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between periodic writes of lease data to the file (only effective when persist=true).

auth.description: Authentication configuration for database access (not used by memfile, but accepted for config compatibility). Leave empty unless overriding.

loggers.description: Configure logging for KEA components. Each object defines a logger name, severity, and output options.

output.description: Output destination: 'stdout', 'stderr', or a file path (e.g., '/var/log/kea/kea.log').

max_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) before log rotation (only applies to file outputs).

max_versions.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

flush.description: Whether to flush output immediately after each log entry (slower but safer).

severity.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL.

debuglevel.description: Debug verbosity level (0–99); higher = more verbose; only effective if compiled with debug support.
